implementation.name: original-v1-irregular-address-transactions
implementation.scope: Four-byte words, sixteen-byte aligned sectors; cold cache/no reuse/within-sector merging. Independent address-dependency example.
implementation.question: Why do equal useful bytes create different memory work?

purpose: Show returned-sector surplus separately from the dependency that prevents an unknown payload address from issuing.
storyboard: Merge adjacent requests into one fetched sector.
Return four scattered sectors for the same useful payload.
Read index, retain its result, then issue and receive a dependent payload.
guard: Not physical DRAM transactions or latency. Address and data values remain distinct; spatial and dependency examples are not combined.
